links.outcome: Hallucinated or unverifiable references among LLM-identified studies
links.effect: LLMs initially identified 39 studies; 28 met some or all validation criteria after excluding hallucinated references (about 11 excluded).
links.quote: LLMs initially identified 39 studies, with 28 meeting some or all the validation criteria after excluding references that were hallucinated.

links.outcome: Whether manual validation of LLM outputs catches hallucinated or incomplete content
links.effect: Manual validation excluded hallucinated references from 39 LLM-identified studies (28 retained); authors conclude LLM outputs were susceptible to hallucinations and incomplete synthesis, requiring human validation.
links.quote: However, LLM outputs were susceptible to hallucinations and incomplete data synthesis, underscoring the need for rigorous clinical oversight and human validation to ensure reliability.

unlisted_practices: Semi-automated RAG extraction with manual validation for literature synthesis and prognostic variable extraction

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance (GPT-4 and Claude Sonnet with RAG) in extracting prognostic clinical variables from scientific literature for neonatal IVH, highlighting hallucinations and the need for human validation without formally testing a deployment safeguard.
